name: Majority Complexity of Majority-Query Separation Products
proof: Coordinatewise majority factors across disjoint Cartesian factors. After an adversarial counterexample in one block, the version space remains a product with only that factor restricted. The majority-query recurrence is therefore additive by induction. Each C_maj factor costs 3, giving total cost 3t.
references: Direct recurrence argument; checked for one and two factors by sync/verify_majority_gap_products.py.
